notes: TS import resolution: a relative specifier (./util) probes to a scanned file; a bare specifier (react) is an external dependency; an @-prefixed specifier (@app/thing) is a potential tsconfig path alias and is reported UNRESOLVED (v1 does not resolve aliases; the status makes the gap explicit rather than guessing).
app -> util -> core -> app is an import cycle; the dependency graph reports exactly one cyclic group (a strongly-connected component). Grep cannot detect an import cycle.
